| Token | Value |

## Illustrations

### Style Specification
- **Type:** 2D flat vector
- **Outlines:** Bold, consistent stroke weight (2px)
- **Color:** Limited palette per archetype (max 4 colors per character)
- **Expressions:** Exaggerated, friendly, Duolingo-like
- **Production:** AI-generated (GPT Image / DALL-E) with strict style prompt, then manually curated

### Character Designs (4 Archetypes)

| Archetype | Character | Props | Expression |
|---|---|---|---|
| Silent Builder | Calm figure with laptop | Laptop, coffee cup, Canva logo hint | Focused, peaceful smile |
| Natural Seller | Energetic figure gesturing | Microphone, ring light hint | Big smile, confident |
| Trend Hunter | Stylish figure with phone | Phone selfie, headphones | Curiosity, eye sparkle |
| Trust Anchor | Warm mentor figure | Handshake gesture, open arms | Welcoming, wise |

### AI Coach Mascot
- **Name:** TBD (Coachy? Ai-Lin?)
- **Design:** Friendly robot/owl hybrid — tech but approachable
- **Usage:** Onboarding chat avatar, loading states, empty states, error screens
- **Variants:** Default (smiling), Thinking (typing dots), Celebrating (confetti), Concerned (error)

## Motion & Animation

### Philosophy: Bouncy + Playful

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Easing** | Spring-based (react-native-reanimated `withSpring`) |
| **Default spring** | `damping: 12, stiffness: 120` |
| **Bouncy spring** | `damping: 8, stiffness: 150` (celebrations) |
| **Duration (non-spring)** | 200ms enter, 150ms exit |

### Animation Catalog

| Event | Animation | Spring Config |
|---|---|---|
| Card enter (list) | Slide up + fade in, staggered 50ms per item | Default spring |
| Button press | Scale 0.97 + haptic light | Duration 100ms |
| XP gain | Counter spins up (`withSequence`), small sparkle burst | Bouncy spring |
| Mission complete | Checkmark scales 0→1.2→1, confetti particles, screen glow | Bouncy spring |
| Streak extend | Flame scales up, screen edge glow pulse, shake | Bouncy spring |
| Level up | Full screen overlay: scale 0.8→1, avatar spins 360°, badge reveal | Bouncy spring |
| Tab switch | Crossfade + slide horizontal, parent position maintained | Default spring |
| Modal open | Scale 0.95→1 + fade in, backdrop blur | Default spring |
| Pull to refresh | Stretch bounce with custom Lottie animation of AI Coach | Default spring |

### Haptic Feedback
- Light: Button press, tab switch, XP gain (routine)
- Medium: Mission complete, streak extend
- Heavy: Level up, first affiliate click

## Components

### Button Hierarchy

| Variant | Style | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `bg-primary` text-white, 16px horizontal padding, 48px height, `radius-md` | Main CTAs: "Mulai", "Generate", "Selesaikan Misi" |
| Secondary | `bg-primary-light` text-primary, same sizing | Secondary actions: "Nanti", "Skip" |
| Ghost | Transparent, text-primary, 44px height | Subtle actions: "Edit", "Lihat detail" |
| Destructive | `bg-error` text-white | "Hapus", "Keluar dari Guild" |
| Icon | 44x44px circle, Phosphor icon centered | Icon-only actions |

### Card Variants

| Variant | Style | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Mission Card | White bg, archetype color left border (4px), `shadow-sm`, `radius-md` | Daily mission items |
| Archetype Badge | Colored bg (archetype), white text, `radius-full`, 20px height | Profile archetype label |
| Stat Card | White bg, centered number (text-2xl), label below, `radius-md` | XP, Streak, Earning |
| Mentor Card | White bg, avatar left, name + archetype, "Adopsi" button right | Mentor Match list |
| Product Card | White bg, product image top, name + price, AI reason badge | Product Recommender |

### Input Fields

| Variant | Style | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Text Input | 48px height, `radius-md`, bg-secondary, 16px padding, border `--color-border` on focus `--color-primary` | Search, caption input, profile edit |
| Chat Input | 44px height, `radius-full`, bg-secondary, send button right-aligned | Onboarding chat |
| Search | Icon left (MagnifyingGlass), rounded, bg-secondary | Leaderboard search, mentor search |

### Empty State Template
```
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│                             │
│       [Illustration]        │  ← AI Coach relevant to context
│                             │
│     Judul (Nunito 700)      │  ← Friendly, contextual
│   Deskripsi 1 kalimat       │  ← Explain WHY empty, not just WHAT
│                             │
│       [Primary CTA]         │  ← Clear next action
│                             │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

Rules:
- NEVER "No items found" — always contextual
- Ilustrasi wajib (AI Coach mascot)
- CTA harus jelas dan actionable
- Tone: encouraging, bukan blaming

```js
    extend: {
      colors: {
        primary: '#58CC02',
        'primary-hover': '#4CAF00',
        'primary-light': '#E8F5E0',
        // ... all tokens from Color System
      },
      fontFamily: {
        heading: ['Nunito-Bold', 'Nunito-ExtraBold'],
        body: ['Inter-Regular', 'Inter-Medium', 'Inter-SemiBold'],
      },
      borderRadius: {
        sm: '8px', md: '12px', lg: '16px', full: '9999px',
      },
    },
  },
};
```

### Animation Libraries
- `react-native-reanimated` — Spring animations, shared transitions
- `lottie-react-native` — Complex animations (confetti, level-up)
- `expo-haptics` — Haptic feedback

## Accessibility Baseline

| Requirement | Spec |
|---|---|
| Contrast ratio | Minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text (24px+) |
| Touch targets | Minimum 44x44px |
| Screen reader | All icons must have `accessibilityLabel`, all images `accessibilityRole="image"` |
| Text scaling | Support up to 1.5x system font scale without breaking layout |
| Motion reduction | Respect `AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled()`, fallback to simple fade |

---

## Anti-Patterns (DO NOT USE)

- ❌ Purple/blue gradient backgrounds
- ❌ 3-column icon feature grids
- ❌ Generic "Welcome back, [Name]!" greeting
- ❌ Centered hero text with decorative blobs
- ❌ Generic avatar circles (pakai karakter Archetype)
- ❌ Empty states with "No items found"
- ❌ MLM terminology: "downline", "upline", "MLM" — ganti dengan "tim", "mentor", "Creator Network"
- ❌ Default blue link color — pakai `--color-primary`
